candidates.change_summary: Delete the overflow check require statement so that Deposit can succeed even when the addition would overflow, altering the resulting balances value.
Delete the balance increment so that Deposit never updates the caller's balance.
Replace the balance increment with a fixed assignment of zero, so Deposit zeros out the caller's balance.
Replace the balance increment with an assignment of msg.value alone, discarding any prior balance.
Change the addition operator to subtraction, radically altering the resulting balance.
Move the Log.AddMessage call before the balance increment so that a reentrant call during Collect can observe the old balance that hasn't been incremented yet.
